fields.description: The address your machines will call, e.g. erp.yourcompany.com or http://erp.yourcompany.com:8081. Shown in every device's setup instructions.
fields.label: Public Server Address

fields.description: Port you type on the machine. 80 is easiest. Use a separate HTTP port (e.g. 8081) if your site forces HTTPS - most eSSL machines only speak HTTP.
fields.label: Port for Machines

fields.description: Optional. Leave empty to use this site's time zone (India: sent to the machine as 330 minutes). Or type hours, e.g. 5.5 or +5:30. ADMS machines set their clock from the server with this.
fields.label: Device Time Zone (hours)

fields.description: A machine that connects for the first time is added to Biometric Device automatically.
fields.label: Auto-register New Machines

fields.description: If off, a new machine shows as 'Pending Approval'. Its punches are kept and processed as soon as you approve it.
fields.label: Auto-approve New Machines

fields.description: Sent by webhook / LAN agent in the header X-Biometric-Token. Use 'Generate API Token' to create one.
fields.label: API Token

fields.default: Device ID, Emp Code or Employee ID
fields.description: How the user ID / PIN from the machine finds the employee. Default tries Attendance Device ID, then Employee Number (Emp Code), then Employee ID.
fields.label: Match Employee By
fields.options:
Device ID, Emp Code or Employee ID
Attendance Device ID
Employee Number (Emp Code)
Employee ID
Custom Employee Field

fields.description: Optional. Fieldname of your own emp code field on Employee, e.g. custom_emp_code. Also checked (last) in the default mode.
fields.label: Custom Employee Field

fields.description: Alternate is safest: many machines send every punch as 'Check-In' unless staff press a key.
fields.label: Decide IN / OUT
fields.options:
Alternate IN / OUT
Device Punch State, else Alternate
Device Punch State Only
Leave Blank (Shift Type decides)

fields.description: For alternate mode: look back this many hours for the previous punch (covers night shifts).
fields.label: Alternate Window (hours)

fields.description: Staff often punch twice. A second punch within this time is marked Duplicate.
fields.label: Ignore Repeat Punch Within (seconds)
Treat 00101 and 101 as the Same ID

fields.description: When a machine is connected for the first time it may upload years of old data. Punches before this date are stored but not turned into checkins.
fields.label: Ignore Punches Before
Reject Punches More Than N Minutes in the Future

fields.description: HRMS Auto Attendance only processes checkins up to this time. Updated every 5 minutes for shift types with Auto Attendance enabled.
fields.label: Update 'Last Sync of Checkin' on Shift Types

fields.description: 0 = keep forever. Employee Checkins are never deleted.
fields.label: Delete Processed Raw Logs After (days)

fields.description: Leave blank - common names like user_id, emp_code, pin, timestamp, punch_time, type, status are detected automatically. Fill only if your system uses unusual names.
fields.label: Webhook Field Mapping (optional)
